description: d_min=0.08 â€” production tail from month 24 onward flattens at 400-600 bbl/month, far above what d_min=0.05 exponential predicts. Raising d_min to capture terminal decline floor. MAPE was 0.5757.

b_initial=1.0 â€” fitted b=0.24 is too low for this shale well; production flattens dramatically from ~800 bbl (month 24) to ~400 bbl (month 30+), suggesting stronger hyperbolic behavior. Raising b_initial to guide optimizer toward higher b. MAPE was 0.5757.

qi_guess_strategy=max3 â€” optimizer stuck at qi=58218/di=0.96/b=0.24 regardless of d_min or b_initial changes. Switching qi anchor from 'first' to 'max3' (avg top 3 months: ~31881 bbl) to explore a different optimization basin. MAPE was 0.5757.

significance_threshold=0.75 â€” excluding ramp-up months below 75% of peak (28200 bbl), so fit starts at peak month 3. Previous 3 experiments changed fitting params but optimizer converged to same solution (qi=58218/di=0.96/b=0.24). Changing training data via preprocessing to break out of local minimum. MAPE was 0.5757.

di_initial=0.30 â€” previous experiments show optimizer converges to same basin (qi=58218/di=0.96/b=0.24) regardless of d_min, b_initial, qi_guess_strategy, or significance_threshold. Trying low di_initial to explore a different optimization basin with lower di and higher b. MAPE was 0.5757.

smoothing_window=5 â€” wider smoothing shifts the detected peak from month 3 (37599 bbl) to later in the ramp-up, reducing apparent decline steepness. This changes qi_guess and the data the optimizer fits, potentially yielding higher b and lower holdout overshoot. MAPE was 0.5757.

outlier_threshold=0.50 â€” more aggressive outlier filtering may remove training months that don't follow the decline trend (e.g. month 18: 852 bbl dip). If outlier_rejection_rate changes from 0.0, different training data enters the optimizer. MAPE was 0.5757.

outlier_window=7 â€” wider rolling median window for outlier detection. With window=7, the median is computed over 7 months instead of 3. Month 18 dip (852 bbl) might be flagged if the 7-month median is high enough. MAPE was 0.5757.
peak_merge_distance=6 â€” wider merge window might consolidate secondary peaks near the main peak differently, potentially shifting the anchor index. MAPE was 0.5757.
